tool.name: Webatlas Process files
tool.command: #if str($input_type.input_type_selector) == 'h5ad': ln -s '$input_h5ad' input.h5ad && python "${__tool_directory__}/process_h5ad.py" input.h5ad ${prefix} && tar -czf output-anndata.zarr.tar.gz ${prefix}-anndata.zarr #elif str($input_type.input_type_selector) == 'spaceranger': mkdir unpacked_spaceranger && tar -xf '${input_spaceranger}' -C unpacked_spaceranger && python "${__tool_directory__}/process_spaceranger.py" unpacked_spaceranger ${prefix} && ##tar -czf output-anndata.zarr.tar.gz ${prefix}-anndata.zarr zip -r output-anndata.zarr.zip ${prefix}-anndata.zarr #elif str($input_type.input_type_selector) == 'xenium': mkdir unpacked_xenium && tar -xf '${input_xenium}' -C unpacked_xenium && python "${__tool_directory__}/process_xenium.py" unpacked_xenium ${prefix} && tar -czf output-anndata.zarr.tar.gz ${prefix}-anndata.zarr #elif str($input_type.input_type_selector) == 'merscope': mkdir unpacked_merscope && tar -xf '${input_merscope}' -C unpacked_merscope && python "${__tool_directory__}/process_merscope.py" unpacked_merscope ${prefix} && tar -czf output-anndata.zarr.tar.gz ${prefix}-anndata.zarr #elif str($input_type.input_type_selector) == 'molecules': python "${__tool_directory__}/process_molecules.py" '${input_molecules}' ${prefix} #end if

param.name: input_type_selector
param.label: Choose the type of input data

param.name: prefix
param.label: Enter a prefix for the output file(s)

data.name: output_zarr
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: compressed zarr output
data.filter: input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'h5ad' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'spaceranger' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'xenium' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'merscope'
